company: Orrin Digital Ltd (fictional UK software and IT services company)

hazard_model.form: monthly logit P(resign) for staff not already on notice

flag_definitions.overtime_high: average overtime over the last 3 months > 20 h a month
flag_definitions.below_band: salary / band midpoint (dept, level, location, current band) < 0.90
flag_definitions.promotion_stalled: level 1-3 and 36+ months since last promotion or hire
flag_definitions.low_engagement: true engagement < 2.9 (survey observes it with noise; disengaged staff respond less)
flag_definitions.bad_manager: line manager is one of the generator's 'bad managers' (not directly in the data)
flag_definitions.rto_mandate: was fully remote at an office location and moved to hybrid on 1 Sep 2024

attributable_resignations.note: expected resignations that would not have happened if only this flag were switched off (direct effect)

engagement_model: engagement = latent - 0.45 overtime_high - 0.40 bad_manager - 0.30 below_band - 0.35 rto_mandate - 0.20 promotion_stalled + noise

events.hiring_freeze: 2025-01 to 2025-06 (fill rate 4 % a month instead of 35 %)
